author: kycrafft
body:
The object of this game is to keel the other team's withers. Yay. There are 2-4 I guess, each with maybe 5 to 20 players. Each team has one wither on a platform, like the one in the pic:
http://i.imgur.com/405ezHd.png

Basicly, the withers' stats shouldn't be  changed too much. Their health could stay at 300 health or 150 hearts. The damage they do however could be modified. I would suggest around wood sword damage for each wither head projectile (and no wither effect).

So around each platform is a wool/iron ring:
http://i.imgur.com/ckBVMl8.png

This marks a few things. Withers cannot target anyone outside of it (possible to code?) and people cannot do melee damage to the withers outside of it ( I tested, they wont be in range). Also, to prevent ganging up on one team, if there are more than 4 players inside 1 ring of a team's platform, they will all get weakness

I know this is complicated, bear with me.

The center of the the map has a fence post with a gold block on it
http://i.imgur.com/pFy7SPJ.png 
This think heals your wither 50 health (25 hearts) if you pick it up. So pick it up becuase it only spawns every 30 seconds

http://i.imgur.com/yokgnMp.png <---This is my 2 minute design. Obviously, it is not going to be a map, its just a general idea of the layout.

Good strategies would be to attack other withers, but if your wither is being attack, run over and knock the attackers out of the way so that they are not within reach of the wither, or to defend your wither (no silly, they don't attack their team) and get the gold block in the middle

A few problems with this minigame:
*There may not be enough people to run good games
*It might be hard/very hard/impossible to code
*I have no idea how long the games will be
*This may need more work, as of now

So, yeah. Feel free to leave some feedback.

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
Good idea; a bit similar to Mega Walls on Hypixel but map design and gameplay should be noticeably different. I think the iron/wool ring around the platforms should be about one block larger in terms of radius; it's too small in my opinion.

I like the concept and I would play this, but like you said it probably needs more work.
